text:
nate: Quick thread to lock down scope for GlowCorp private pilot. Product wants a small-ish MVP: per-tenant reserved concurrency, a fast prewarm path, KMS for tenant keys, and a clear fallback/telemetry plan. Target launch window: ~6 weeks. Who owns what?
priya: Need acceptance criteria from product. Also call out cost limits — customer asked for <20% premium vs hosted.
omar: From runtime: we can do a "warming snapshot" + short-lived KV restore. Estimate: proto 2w, harden 2w. Risks: cold-starts if snapshot TTL expires and spiky traffic.
felix: Infra: region-us-central has spare capacity. We can allocate 12 reserved concurrency slots now, but they are soft: preemptible under cluster pressure. Node add to hard-reserve is ~3w.
priya: Security: KMS path must be in place for pilot. HSM parity optional. Need audit hooks + per-tenant key-use logs. ETA to scope & doc: 6 business days.
nate: Proposed minimal launch criteria: 1) warm flow p95 < 200ms for 64-token prompts, 2) cold fallback path defined with SLA (<=5% routed to hosted under normal load), 3) per-tenant billing tags emitted, 4) key decrypt on boot via KMS + 30d audit retention.
omar: Agree on perf target. Implementation note: prewarm TTL default 10m, configurable per-tenant. I'll provide perf harness.
felix: Fallback policy: route to hosted if reserved queue depth > 80% for >15s. We can emit a metric reserved_slot_pressure and a histogram of fallback latency. Need product to pick acceptable fallback % (nate?).
priya: Product asks for fallback <=3% for pilot. Also need explicit rollback criteria: if p99 of fallback > 1s or error rate > 0.5% revert to hosted-only.
nate: Accepted. Owners: runtime = omar, infra = felix, security = priya, product = nate. Can each owner add ETA?
omar: Owner runtime (warming snapshot + harness) — ETA: 14 days (proto) + 10 days (validation) => finishing by May 10. Will open PR + perf doc.
felix: Owner infra (reserve 12 soft slots + metrics pipeline + fallback rule) — ETA: carve slots by Apr 5, metrics + routing by Apr 12. Node add if needed by May 1.
priya: Owner security (KMS path, audit spec, key lifecycle) — ETA: Apr 9 for checklist + gating items. HSM out-of-scope for pilot.
nate: Product will write acceptance tests and billing tags. ETA: Apr 7. I'll include sample testcases and the customer notify message.
priya: Two small asks: 1) need a config API shape for reserved slots and prewarm TTL so security can review, 2) we need an instrumented canary path and a way to opt-out the pilot customer quickly.
omar: Config draft coming tonight. Example snippet:
```yaml
reserved_concurrency:
  tenant_id: glowcorp
  slots: 12
  prewarm_ttl: 10m
  fallback_policy:
    threshold_pct: 80
    sustain_secs: 15
    route: hosted_pool
```
felix: For canary we can add a header X-Redwood-Pilot: glowcorp and a gate in the router. ops-bot: created canary flag.
ops-bot: Meeting scheduled: "GlowCorp pilot handshake" Thu 9:30am PT 0 participants invited: @nate @priya @omar @felix.
priya: I'll validate the KMS decryption flow against the config patch. Also confirm audit retention (30d) is ok.
nate: 30d is fine for pilot. Post any blockers here. After the meeting we should checkpoint acceptance tests and run an end-to-end dry run against a staging tenant.
omar: I'll attach perf results and a simple harness command in the ticket tonight. Quick command to run locally:
```
runtime_benchmark --tenant glowcorp --tokens 64 --warm=true --iters 200
```
felix: I'll add capacity dashboard and an alert for reserved_slot_pressure > 90%.
priya: One more: who owns customer comms if we need to delay? Product (nate) will own comms.
nate: Got it. Thanks everyone. Will post the roadmap update and owners with dates. :thumbsup:
